mechanism: Both drugs can cause CNS effects and behavioral changes; montelukast is metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2C8 while haloperidol is a CYP3A4 substrate and inhibitor, potentially increasing montelukast levels.
action: Monitor for increased montelukast neuropsychiatric side effects (behavioral changes, mood alterations) and consider haloperidol dose adjustment if needed; use with caution in patients with psychiatric history.
